positions.name: SlugGenerationOnMissingId
positions.frame: what must the pipeline do when a memory arrives without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition — a submission lacking an explicit id — and src-2 states the operational requirement that condition imposes: the pipeline must derive a slug (via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback) and commit the file. Read together, the pair is true because of what each describes: the absent-id state and the mandated response to it. The register and power reads both mark src-2 as a technical, process-authority directive ('must'), while src-1 is a flat factual assertion — a tension between plain description and command that the frame holds without resolving.
